acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance is an owner decision over the exact cross-system evidence set; no local, CI, deployment, or AgentFlow receipt alone proves customer or business outcomes.
evidenceRequired: Exact-revision governance, full CI, rendered desktop/mobile, accessibility, AgentFlow, and recovery evidence are present.
The final report separates local, CI, execution, deployment, production, customer-acceptance, and outcome claims.

completionCriteria: The ratified operator journey is exercised end to end from repository evidence through assumption, decision comparison, adopted backlog, approved handoff, externally produced AgentFlow receipt, outcome assessment, and human learning decision.
Fresh screenshots document every material desktop and mobile step, including success, blocked, stale, invalid, loading, empty, error, and recovery states.

Keyboard order, focus movement, accessible names, live announcements, reduced motion, contrast, target size, 200 percent zoom, and responsive reflow have explicit evidence; screenshot review alone is not treated as accessibility compliance.

Governance audit, intent/architecture/intelligence planes, whole-backlog status, quick CI, standard cross-browser CI, and full CI pass at the exact candidate revision without threshold or baseline weakening.
AgentFlow execution and receipt evidence remain external to Proofloom and require separately verified commits, validations, ownership, and handoff equivalence.
The final report distinguishes local implementation, CI, AgentFlow execution, deployment, provider behavior, production observation, customer acceptance, and business outcomes.
A repository owner records the final accept, defer, or reject decision; no automated check substitutes for that decision.
nonObjectives: Do not claim deployment, production readiness, customer acceptance, or business outcomes from local or CI evidence.
Do not update visual baselines silently or weaken governed thresholds.
Do not close another task merely because this acceptance review ran.
objective: Qualify the complete Proofloom decision-to-execution-to-learning journey with fresh rendered, accessibility, governance, AgentFlow, and claim-boundary evidence.
title: Qualify Proofloom end-to-end acceptance
